name: VibeWave v2.4.3
body:
### 🎨 VibeWave v2.4.3 - 10 Custom App Logos & Launcher Icons!

- 🌟 **10 Stylish VibeWave Logos:** Settings > User Interface > 'App Logo & Icon' me jakar apne manpasand logo ko chunein! Classic Cyan, Neon Sunset, Royal Violet, Golden Symphony, Emerald Beats, Midnight AMOLED, Crimson Fire, Ocean Depths, Sakura Dream, Monochrome Pro!
- 📱 **Dynamic App Launcher Icon:** Selected logo aapke mobile ki Home Screen aur App Drawer icon par bhi apply hota hai!
- ⚡ **In-App Top Bar Logo:** Home Screen ke top par 'VibeWave' ke sath selected logo ka waveform badge chamkega!
- 🔄 **Direct In-App Seamless Update:** Zero duplicate files in Downloads folder!
